fact.text: It was the first song to hold a spot in the Billboard Hot 100 top ten for an entire year.
It interpolates TLC's "No Scrubs", so that song's writers are credited too.
It began when Jesse Rutherford heard Zach Abels playing guitar and said "let me record that".
It gave Daft Punk their only Billboard Hot 100 chart-topper.
Its 15 weeks at number one made it the longest-running US chart-topper by a UK act.
Featured artist Wizkid became the first Nigerian artist to top the Billboard Hot 100.

answers.name: Sunflower
answers.article: Sunflower (Post Malone and Swae Lee song)

fact.text: Written for Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, it became the first song certified double diamond in the US.
Lewis Capaldi wrote it about his late grandmother, and says it took him six months.
The lyrics came after a visit to James Blunt's house in Ibiza, listening to Future at six in the morning.

fact.text: It grew out of a melody Charlie Puth played on keyboard at producer Blake Slatkin's house.
